description: This file defines a fragment for the home screen in an Android TV application using the Leanback library. It sets up multiple rows of content including workouts, progress charts, badges, profile, and goals, and handles user interactions such as clicking on items to start activities or show other fragments.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A fragment displaying the main home screen with multiple content rows including workouts, progress, badges, and profile options, using Android's Leanback library.

classes.name: HomeFragment.StringPresenter
classes.description: A custom presenter for displaying simple string-based items within the Leanback UI, such as profile and goals options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up the UI and builds the content rows.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Configures the user interface settings such as title, colors, headers, and search listener.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Constructs the multiple content rows displayed in the home screen, including workouts, progress chart, badges, and profile options.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Sets click listeners for handling user interactions with items in the UI.

methods.name: openVoiceSearch
methods.description: Opens the voice search or search fragment.

methods.name: StringPresenter
methods.description: Inner class that creates and binds views for string items like 'Profile' and 'Goals'.
